title: WebSocket hardening, history and local release docs
intent: Make reconnect/close/history behavior deterministic, close the accepted stage 10 carry-forward debt and the Block child-cleanup leak, and document a reproducible local release boundary without production claims.

requirements.title: Runtime hardening and release boundary
requirements.description: Add reconnect/backoff, cleanup and history pagination, close the stage 10 carry-forward UX debt (NEW-1, NEW-2/NEW-3, RV5/RV6) and the Block __children destroy leak, then document local own-backend operation, rollback/preflight and progress while preserving repository governance.

constraints: Stage 7 owns mode-specific adapters; shared WSTransport is hardened here.
Docs do not alter course CI/deploy or principles authority.
Stage 10 carry-forward fixes stay inside src/features/ai-assistant and shared utils with one regression test per finding.
Block core changes are limited to destroy-time child cleanup plus the minimal compile-time capture of the __children list, with existing Block tests kept green.
Composition edits inside src/features/chats and src/components/messenger are strictly additive.
